name: bssid_top_k_set_fingerprint_no_magnitudes
success_criterion: test MAE < 10.5 m AND kNN-only val_mae < 11 m (sanity)
rationale: Highest confidence cross-session win on MSILN: discards RSSI magnitudes entirely (the documented drift substrate), uses Jaccard kNN over top-K AP sets with an IMU delta corrector. Cheap (~5 min on P4000), kill-fast diagnostic (kNN-only val sanity), and orthogonal to every deep-encoder lead we've tried. Pre-existing project audit explicitly named magnitude drift as the failure mode; this lead removes it by construction.

name: per_path_trajectory_cost_minimization
success_criterion: val MAE < 17 m AND test MAE < 9.5 m
rationale: Largest expected lift (4 m) backed by Kaggle-MSILN precedent. No training: kNN + L-BFGS per-path solve in ~10 min on CPU. Exploits per-path structure that no deep lead can use. Even with lam_rel=0 (kNN+smoothness only) it's a known +1 m gain, so failure mode is bounded.

name: whole_path_bidirectional_transformer
rationale: Exploits the long-path information-theoretic prior (sqrt(500) noisy obs of a smooth 2D path). Single self-contained script; high confidence rating. Different mechanism from cost-min (learned smoothing vs analytic NLLS) so both can live in the landscape map.

name: hierarchical_zone_then_residual_head
success_criterion: val MAE < 9.5 m AND zone_acc on val > 0.4
rationale: Cheap output-head swap on existing backbone. CE-loss decomposition is high-signal diagnostic (zone_acc directly tells us if wrong-room jumps are the failure). Different mechanism from heatmap (keeps regression for fine offset, no quantisation floor). Strong paper story: 'where does the WiFi confuse rooms'.

name: pairwise_rssi_difference_invariant
success_criterion: test MAE < 10 m AND val-test gap < baseline gap of 5.5 m
rationale: Physics-motivated session-invariance via RSSI-difference (cancels per-receiver gain). Drops into FusionTrainer cleanly. Diagnostic value beyond MAE: val-test gap is the publishable signal regardless of absolute number.

name: differentiable_knn_over_learned_rssi_metric
success_criterion: test MAE < 10.5 m AND val-test gap < 0.8 m
rationale: Non-parametric head sidesteps the regressor-overfit problem. Learned metric only needs neighbour ORDERING preserved (weaker condition than alignment). Strong test-vs-val gap signal even if absolute MAE doesn't beat lead3.

name: session_maml_with_first_path_support
success_criterion: test MAE < 10.5 m AND adaptation contributes >= 0.5 m vs no-adapt
rationale: Only lead that spends labelled test-session shots (Reptile + 20-shot adapt). MetaLoc precedent shows 30-50% MED reduction; perfectly fits MSILN's per-session structure. Safety-floor is the unadapted base, so worst case is no harm.

name: mixture_density_network_with_mc_dropout
success_criterion: test MAE < 10.5 m AND effective n_components (entropy of pi) > 1.5
rationale: Lowest-risk generative lead: just swap final 2D head for K=6 GMM + MC dropout. Anisotropic uncertainty matches corridor geometry. Tiny overhead vs baseline (~12 min). High confidence on convergence; the entropy bonus mitigates the canonical MDN collapse failure.

name: mamba_imu_place_conditioned_encoder
success_criterion: test MAE < 9.5 m (beats idea1 mean 9.93 by >0.4 m)
rationale: Replaces transformer trunk with selective SSM â€” fundamentally different inductive bias (input-dependent forgetting matches PDR physics). MambaIO precedent; Pascal-safe pure-Python fallback included. Builds on idea1 winning recipe with an architectural swap.

name: path_id_and_ap_visibility_classification_auxiliaries
success_criterion: val MAE < 11.0 m AND path-cls acc > 0.5 by epoch 10
rationale: Adds two free supervision signals on the fused [CLS] (path-ID and next-scan AP-set). Both exploit unused information (path labels, AP presence) without touching the WiFi encoder. Annealable lambdas mitigate the closed-set risk on test paths 128-132.
